questions.question: Three articles are bought at Rs. 200 each. One of them is sold at a loss of 10%. If the other two articles are sold so as to gain 20% on the whole transaction, then what is the gain percent on the two articles?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of 3 articles is Rs.200 each

Total gain percentage on whole transaction = 20%

**Calculation:**

Total CP of 3 articles = 200 × 3 = 600

So, SP of all three articles = 600 × 120/100 = 720

SP of 1st article = 200 – 200 × 10% = 180

CP of other 2 article = 400

SP of 2 other article = 720 – 180 = 540

Profit on 2 article = 540 – 400 = 140

Profit percentage of 2 article = (140/400) × 100 = 35%

**∴ The gain percent on the two articles is 35%**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 3 and xy + yz + zx = -18, then what is the value of x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 3 and xy + yz + zx = -18

**Calculation:**

x + y + z = 3

Squaring both sides

x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 9

⇒ x² + y² + z² + 2 × (-18) = 9

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 9 + 36 = 45

Now

x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = (x + y + z) (x² + y² + z² – xy – yz – zx)

= 3 × [45 – (-18)] = 3 × 63 = 189

**∴ x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = 189**

questions.question: Sudha decided to donate 12% of her monthly income to an orphanage. On the day of donation, she changed her decision and donated a sum of Rs. 4800 which was equal to 80% of what she had decide earlier. What is 27% of her monthly income?
questions.solution:
**Topper's approach∶**

Required income = 4800 ÷ (0.12 × 0.8) × 100 × 0.27 = 13500

**Detailed solution∶**

Let monthly income be E

According to question

E × 12% × 80% = 4800

⇒ E × (12/100) × (80/100) = 4800

⇒ E = 50000

∴ Monthly income of Sudha = 50000

∴ 27% of monthly income = 50000 × 27% = 50000 × 27/100 = 13500 rupees

questions.question: A sum invested at 8% p.a. amounts to Rs. 20280 at the end of one year, when the interest is compounded half yearly. What will be simple interest on the same sum for 4(3)/(5) years at double the earlier rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Annual rate = 8%

Since interest compounded half yearly

∴ r = 4% and time = 2 half yearly

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be P

P (1 + r/100)t = 20280

⇒ P (1 + 4/100)² = 20280

⇒ P × 104/100 × 104/100 = 20280

⇒ P = 18750

Now,

P = 18750

Interest = 8 × 2 = 16%

Time = 23/5 year

Simple interest = (p × r × t)/100 = (18750 × 16 × 23)/(5 × 100) = 13800 rupees

questions.question: A can do 40% of a work in 6 days and B can do 30% of the same work in 3 days. They started the work together but B left after 2 days and A continued to work. In how many days was the entire work completed?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

A can do 40% of a work in 6 days

∴ A can do 100% of the work in 15 days

B can do 30% of the same work in 3 days

∴ B can do 100% of the same work in 10 days

Total work = LCM of (15 and 10) = 30

Efficiency of A = 30/15 = 2

Efficiency of B = 30/10 = 3

Work done by A and B together in 2 days = 5 × 2 = 10

Remaining work = 30 – 10 = 20

Remaining work done by A = 20/2 = 10 days

**∴ Total Number of days = 10 + 2 = 12 days**

questions.question: A train covers a certain distance in 45 minutes. If its speed is reduced by 5 km/h, it takes 3 minutes more to cover the same distance. The distance (in km) is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the distance be D km

Speed = Distance/Time = D/(45/60) = 60D/45 = (4D/3) km/h

The speed of train is reduced by 5 km/h

∴ New speed = (4D/3) – 5 = (4D – 15)/3 km/h

New time = 45min + 3min = 48min

48/60 × (4D – 15)/3 = D

⇒ 16 (4D – 15) = 60D

⇒ 4 (4D – 15) = 15D

⇒ 16D – 60 = 15D

⇒ D = 60

∴ The distance = 60 km

questions.question: If 8(a + b)³ + (a - b)³ = (3a + b) (Aa² + Bab + Cb²), then what is the value of (A + B - C)?
questions.solution:
8(a + b)³ + (a - b)³ = (3a + b) (Aa² + Bab + Cb²)

⇒ [2(a + b)]³ + (a – b)³ = (3a + b) (Aa² + Bab + Cb²)

⇒ (2a + 2b)³ + (a – b)³ = (3a + b) (Aa² + Bab + Cb²)

⇒ (2a + 2b + a – b) [4a² + 4b² + 8ab + a² + b² – 2ab – (2a² – 2b²)] = (3a + b) (Aa² + Bab + Cb²)

⇒ (3a + b) (3a² + 6ab + 7b²) = (3a + b) (Aa² + Bab + Cb²)

⇒ (3a² + 6ab + 7b²) = (Aa² + Bab + Cb²)

By comparing both sides

A = 3, B = 6 and C = 7

Now,

(A + B - C) = (3 + 6 – 7) = 2

∴ (A + B - C) = 2

questions.question: If a 10-digit number 75y97405x2 is divisible by 72, then the value of (2x - y), for the greatest value of x, is:
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

When a number is divisible by 72 then it must be divisible by 8 × 9

When a number is divisible by 8 then its last 3 digit must be divisible by 8

**Calculation:**

5x2 is divisible by 8

When x = 5 or x = 9

We have to take greatest value of x

So x = 9

When a number is divisible by 9 then the sum of its digit must be multiple of 9

7 + 5 + y + 9 + 7 + 4 + 0 + 5 + 9 + 2 = 48 + y

So the possible value of y = 6

**∴ 2x – y = 2 × 9 – 6 = 12**

questions.question: The average of n numbers is 36. If each of 75% of the numbers is increased by 6 and each of the remaining numbers is decreased by 9, then the new average of the numbers is:
questions.solution:
Let the total number = 100

Average = 36 (given)

Total = 36 × 100 = 3600

75% of 100 = 75

Total increase in 75 numbers = 75 × 6 = 450

Total decrease in 25 numbers = 25 × -9 = 225

∴ Total increase in 100 numbers = 450 – 225 = 225

Now

Total = 3600 + 225 = 3825

Average = 3825/100 = 38.25%
